## Power Sessions 0.3.0

Quick action rows are easier to scan and no longer move when an action starts or stops.

- Edit now starts each quick action row and Run or Stop ends it. A running action's green dot sits just before Stop.
- While an action runs, Edit stays in place, disabled, instead of disappearing. Its tooltip says to stop the action first when the row has a Stop button.
- Every button in a row keeps its place, so starting, stopping or learning an action's address never shifts the name or the other buttons.
- An action can show its own icon, one character or emoji such as 🚀, in place of the edit icon. Set it in the new Icon field of the add or edit form; ⌃ ⌘ Space opens the macOS emoji picker there.
- The add form says how the commands run, and the URL's note now sits under the URL field.
